coordinate_system: world x right, world y up; TAS pot pixels unprojected with live Unity spawn camera lock, then TAS relative camera motion
coordinate_warning: Spawn camera is the live Unity camera at spawn_upright. Later cameras keep TAS relative motion and zoom; they are not independently live-measured. Pot pixels remain TAS gold/rigid fusion, not live_dark_contour_v1.
interpolation_method: piecewise linear in world coordinates; speed/reversal/terrain gates; no extrapolation

interpolation_holdout.reference: held-out CV observations, not game ground truth
